description_expanded: This Alys Beach Vacation Rental is brand new and perfectly positioned directly across the street from ZUMA Wellness Center and a short walk to the Caliza Pool Complex. Guests will enjoy a courtyard with private pool, built-in grill and covered dining area. Inside, the first level offers a spacious great room with ample seating, a gas fireplace, an open kitchen with a large center island, dining area and the primary suite with a king-sized bed. On the second level, guests will find three bedrooms, all with private baths. Two of the bedrooms offer one king-sized bed and the third bedroom offers one queen-sized bed and three bunk beds. Finally, there Guests at this home will find a covered outdoor balcony with seating, a wetbar area for entertaining and a spacious open roof-top deck with an outdoor fireplace. Parking for this home is located in a two-vehicle garage. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
